dict.string: This app requests access to your camera to facilitate your shooting and uploading of videos or photos. The camera function provides convenience for you to record your life and share wonderful moments. All the captured data will be securely stored on your personal device. We promise that we will only upload or share this content after obtaining your explicit consent.

This app requests access to the microphone, aiming to provide you with a smooth voice chat experience. Please rest assured that we will not use or obtain any audio content without authorization. Only after obtaining your explicit permission will we access and operate on the relevant audio data.

This app requests access to your album so that you can select and upload videos or other pictures from it. We will strictly follow the purpose of your authorization when using the files you have selected. These files will be securely stored on your device and will never be shared with others without your prior permission.
